title: P19 — Run local workers on portable bundles
description:
## Dispatch packet P19
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D08,D09 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
Babulus
Primary paths: src/worker.ts; worker-lib.ts; local worker CLI. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Consume bundle with installed pinned renderer, heartbeat and upload attempt-scoped artifacts. Terminate child processes on cancel/lease loss; authenticated enrollment gives worker only assigned jobs.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
real local render completes, claims survive slow work, stale worker cannot publish, local-only never submits cloud.

## Dependencies
videoml-e97334 (P18)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.
